question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**legislative**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage refers to the concept of democracy and how it affects the citizens living in the country.
 
• Now, blank 3 will refer to a process related to law and order as mentioned earlier in the passage as well.
 
• Therefore, the correct word to use in blank 3 is "legislative."
 
 
• "Legislative" means relating to the making of laws, which makes sense in the context of the sentence.(विधायी)
 
• Example: Today's hearing was just the first step in the legislative process. 
 
 
 
• The other words do not fit the context of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "copulative" means relating to or serving as a conjunction, which does not fit the context of the sentence.(संयोजक)
 
• "perennial" means lasting or existing for a long or apparently infinite time, which is also not appropriate in this context.(चिरस्थायी)
 
• "relative" means considered in relation or in proportion to something else, which is not relevant in this sentence.(सापेक्ष)
